findings.detail: He would spend one day at his lodging and one day in the academy.
He arose and hid it for the righteous.
‘Heaven and earth’ are names of the Holy One, blessed be He.
These are Torah scholars who constrain themselves from sleep over words of Torah in this world; the Holy One, blessed be He, reveals to them the secret of the river in the World to Come.

Why are words of Torah compared to a nut? To tell you: Just as a nut, though soiled with mud and excrement, has contents that do not become repulsive, so a Torah scholar, though he sins, has Torah that does not become repulsive.
